description: This file contains the implementation of a project initialization framework, including classes for project templates, template providers, and file system helpers. It manages project structure generation, script execution, and configuration handling for various project types.

classes.name: ProcessingStep
classes.description: Enum for processing steps (Pre-processing and Post-processing).

classes.name: ProjectTemplate
classes.description: Abstract base class for project templates, defining core methods for initialization, structure generation, and testing setup.

classes.name: ProjectTemplateFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating project template instances based on project type.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main orchestrator class for initializing projects and managing templates.

classes.name: FileSystemHelper
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods for copying files and directories with variable replacements.

methods.name: ProjectTemplate.get_run_command
methods.description: Returns the command to run the project.

methods.name: ProjectTemplate.get_entry_point_url
methods.description: Returns the entry point URL for the project.

methods.name: ProjectTemplate.initialize
methods.description: Performs project initialization including validation, structure generation, testing setup, and post-processing.

methods.name: ProjectTemplate.wait_for_post_process_completed
methods.description: Waits for post-processing to complete with a timeout.

methods.name: ProjectTemplate._run_processing_script
methods.description: Runs a processing script in background or synchronously.

methods.name: ProjectTemplateFactory.create_template
methods.description: Creates a project template instance based on project configuration.

methods.name: ProjectInitializer.initialize_project
methods.description: Initializes a project using the appropriate template.

methods.name: FileSystemHelper.copy_template
methods.description: Copies template files with variable replacements, including extra files or directories.
